test_title: PYST 40: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 25 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: All of the following options, except one, contain sentences in the Future tense. Select the grammatically INCORRECT sentence.

options.text: I am sure you will pass the exam.
The jacket will look nice on you.
I think we will meeting again before long.
I think you will like George if you meet him.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Option 3 contains a grammatical error in the sentence: **"I think we will meeting again before long."**
 
• The verb form "**meeting**" is incorrect in this context as it is not in the future tense.
 
• In future tense sentences, the structure should be "will + base verb" (e.g., "will meet").
 
• The correct sentence should be: **"I think we will meet again before long."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I think we will meet again before long."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "I am sure you will pass the exam."** – This sentence is grammatically correct and in future tense.
 
• **Option 2: "The jacket will look nice on you."** – This sentence is grammatically correct and in future tense.
 
• **Option 4: "I think you will like George if you meet him."** – This sentence is grammatically correct and in future tense.
